title: Personal Protection Order (PPO) Hearing
what_it_is: A hearing on a petition for a personal protection order, or on a motion to modify/terminate one already entered. PPOs cannot be made mutual, and an existing custody/parenting-time order does not automatically survive unmodified once a PPO takes precedence (MCR 3.706(C)(3)).
who_is_in_the_room: The petitioner (who must attend, MCR 3.705(B)(4)) and the respondent, if the hearing is contested.
sequence: If the petition sought an ex parte order, the court must rule within one business day of filing (MCR 3.705(A)(1)); an ex parte order is valid for not less than 182 days (MCR 3.705(A)(3)).
If no ex parte order was requested, or one was refused and a hearing is requested, the court schedules a hearing as soon as possible (MCR 3.705(B)(1)).
The hearing is held on the record (MCR 3.705(B)(3)); the petitioner must attend or the court may adjourn or dismiss (MCR 3.705(B)(4)).
At the conclusion, the court states its reasons for granting or denying on the record, and in writing if denying (MCR 3.705(B)(6)).
A respondent to an ex parte order may move to modify or terminate within 14 days of service/actual notice (MCR 3.706(A)(7)).

If custody/parenting time is affected, the issuing court must contact the court with jurisdiction over that matter (MCR 3.706(C)(1)); a party seeking to modify the existing custody/parenting-time order must file a motion, with a hearing held within 21 days (MCR 3.706(C)(3)(a)).
prepare: Specific facts, in an affidavit or verified petition, of the conduct you rely on - dates, what happened, how you know.
Copies of any existing custody/parenting-time order that may be affected.
A safety plan for attending: separate waiting areas, staggered arrival, or a remote appearance request made in advance.

applicable_rules.summary: The court must rule on a request for an ex parte PPO within one business day of filing.
An ex parte order is valid for not less than 182 days and must state its expiration date.
An ex parte PPO must state that the restrained individual may, within 14 days of service or actual notice, file a motion to modify or terminate it and request a hearing.
A party seeking to modify an existing custody/parenting-time order affected by a PPO must file a motion, with a hearing held within 21 days of filing.

deadlines.label: Ruling on an ex parte PPO request
Motion to modify/terminate an ex parte PPO
Hearing on a motion to modify the existing custody/parenting-time order

traps.trap: Believing a PPO can run both directions.
traps.safe_move: Mutual PPOs are prohibited (MCR 3.706(B)). A cross-petition is a separate proceeding.

traps.trap: Missing that the PPO takes precedence over an existing custody/parenting-time order.
traps.safe_move: It does, until the PPO expires or the other court modifies its order to accommodate it (MCR 3.706(C)(3)).
Failure to appear can lead to adjournment or dismissal (MCR 3.705(B)(4)).

traps.trap: Trying to use the PPO hearing to litigate the whole custody dispute.
traps.safe_move: Stay on the conduct the petition alleges; custody/parenting-time changes go through the separate motion track (MCR 3.706(C)(3)(a)).

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.
Do not contact the other party to discuss the petition or order, in person or by proxy, while it is pending or in force.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Write down the date, who appeared, and what was decided or taken under advisement before leaving the building.
Write on any document handed to you the date you received it - that date can start a clock.
Calendar every deadline this event started, counted from the earliest possible trigger date.
Note whether anything was requested that you did not have time to answer fully, and follow up in writing.
